config.scope: Synthetic conditions and counterexamples, not measured RID detection performance
assumptions: One physical transmitter; no relay, clone or receiver-specific beamforming
Correct physical event association is an oracle in full/partial modes
Observers report honestly; positions and exponent known; receiver residual fixed across calibration/test
Coverage is geometry plus independent scan deletion, not power-dependent RF sensitivity
Gaussian independent link noise, no NLOS, no quantization, no empirical RF calibration
Normal claimed position equals true position; no normal GNSS error
A statistic rejects inconsistency only; it does not attribute attack cause or authenticate aircraft
All coordinates, power values and trajectories are fictional

interpretation: Alarm means model inconsistency, never cause attribution. A missing conditional rate is undefined, not zero.
weighting: Equal independent synthetic seed means; events within a flight are not independent trials.
